arxiv-1604-08256.creator: Ricardo Fabbri, Benjamin B. Kimia
arxiv-1604-08256.description: Abstract The field of multiple view geometry has seen tremendous progress in reconstruction and calibration due to methods for extracting reliable point features and key developments in projective geometry. Point features, however, are not available in certain applications and result in unstructured point cloud reconstructions.

arxiv-2011-01034.title: Wavefronts for degenerate diffusion-convection reaction equations with sign-changing diffusivity
arxiv-2011-01034.creator: Diego Berti, Andrea Corli, Luisa Malaguti
arxiv-2011-01034.description: Abstract We consider in this paper a diffusion-convection reaction equation in one space dimension. The main assumptions are about the reaction term, which is monostable, and the diffusivity, which changes sign once or even more than once; then, we deal with a forward-backward parabolic equation.

arxiv-2311-12248.title: Sparse graph counting and Kelley–Meka bounds for binary systems
arxiv-2311-12248.creator: Yuval Filmus, Hamed Hatami, Kaave Hosseini, Esty Kelman
arxiv-2311-12248.description: Abstract In a recent breakthrough, Kelley and Meka (FOCS 2023) obtained a strong upper bound on the density of sets of integers without non-trivial three-term arithmetic progressions. In this work, we extend their result, establishing similar bounds for all linear patterns defined by binary systems of linear forms, where “binary” indicates that every linear form depends on exactly two variables.

arxiv-2404-03791.title: Accretion and Uneven Depletion of the Main Asteroid Belt
arxiv-2404-03791.creator: Rogerio Deienno, David Nesvorný, Matthew S. Clement, William F. Bottke, André Izidoro, Kevin J. Walsh
arxiv-2404-03791.description: Abstract The main asteroid belt (MAB) is known to be primarily composed of objects from two distinct taxonomic classes, generically defined here as S- and C-complex. The former probably originated from the inner solar system (interior to Jupiter’s orbit), while the latter probably from the outer solar system.

arxiv-2507-14483.title: Abrupt transitions in the optimization of diffusion with distributed resetting
arxiv-2507-14483.creator: Pedro Julián-Salgado, Leonardo Dagdug, Denis Boyer
arxiv-2507-14483.description: Abstract Brownian diffusion subject to stochastic resetting to a fixed position has been widely studied for applications to random search processes. In an unbounded domain, the mean first passage time at a target site can be minimized for a convenient choice of the resetting rate.

pmc-12706889.creator: Kunyan Xu, Jianing Yang, Meng Yan, Dan Li, Wenli Du, Jing Bai, Bai Xiang
pmc-12706889.description: BackgroundRespiratory diseases are a major global health burden, and inhalation therapy offers efficient pulmonary targeting and therapeutic effectiveness. pmc-13043253.description: With the emergence of summary statistics from large-scale genome-wide association studies (GWAS), polygenic risk scores (PRSs) are increasingly used to assess the genetic risk of asthma. pmc-13185890.title: Swedish trends in excision arthroplasty of the acromioclavicular joint during 2008-2023: a population-based register study
pmc-13185890.creator: Viktor Mili-Schmidt, Kristofer Hallberg, Michael Axenhus
pmc-13185890.description: BackgroundExcision arthroplasty of the acromioclavicular (AC) joint is a common procedure for degenerative, post-traumatic, and overload-related AC joint pathology; however, population-based data from Scandinavia are lacking. This study aimed to describe national trends in AC joint excision in Sweden from 2008 to 2023 and to forecast future incidence to 2040.

pmc-13285091.creator: Wenxiu Zheng, Hairong Zhang
pmc-13285091.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThis study analyzed the impact of a cognitive-motor training program on key indicators of cognitive performance.MethodsA two-arm, parallel, randomised controlled trial (with 1:1 allocation) was conducted. A total of 184 competitive eSports athletes (aged 18–25) were randomly assigned to one of two programmes: an individualised psychophysical training programme integrating aerobic exercise and cognitive self-regulation techniques, or a standard eSports training programme. Outcomes were assessed at baseline, after 4 weeks (mid-intervention) and after 8 weeks (post-intervention).

pmc-13578924.creator: Masaki Tanaka, Yuri Ozaki, Takuo Otsuka, Takahide Hongo, Mari Tone, Yuhei Kinehara, Shoichi Ihara, Yoshito Takeda, Ryu Jokoji, Isao Tachibana
pmc-13578924.description: Pulmonary amyloidosis is a rare disease with diverse radiological manifestations that may mimic malignancy or diffuse interstitial lung disease. Although conventional forceps transbronchial lung biopsy (TBLB) is an established less invasive diagnostic method, its clinical role may differ according to disease presentation. We report three patients with pulmonary amyloidosis diagnosed by conventional forceps TBLB.

zoist-vol-04-1846.title: The Zoist: A Journal of Cerebral Physiology & Mesmerism, Vol. IV (April 1846 to January 1847)
zoist-vol-04-1846.creator: John Elliotson (editor)
zoist-vol-04-1846.description: Vol. IV of The Zoist (1843–1856), the first and most important English journal devoted to mesmerism and cerebral physiology, founded by John Elliotson. Thirteen volumes form the movement's complete primary record: surgical cases, somnambulist reports, and the mesmerism-to-hypnotism debate.
